import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Define locations
loc1 = ee.Geometry.Point([136.025799, 33.710618])  # lon, lat
loc2 = ee.Geometry.Point([136.367495, 33.884848])

# Date of interest
date = '2018-09-15'
start_date = ee.Date(date)
end_date = start_date.advance(1, 'day')

# MODIS Terra Aerosol Product (MOD04) - best for turbidity/aerosol measurement
# Using MOD04_3K for Aerosol Optical Depth
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_3K') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date)

size = col.size().getInfo()
print(f"MODIS MOD04 Images on {date}: {size}")

if size == 0:
    # Fallback to MOD09GA (surface reflectance) for turbidity proxy
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date)
    size = col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"Fallback to MOD09GA: {size} images")
    
    if size == 0:
        print("No MODIS data found for 2018-09-15.")
        print("C1")
    else:
        # Use red/blue ratio as turbidity proxy
        img = col.first()
        
        # Extract red (620-670nm) and blue (459-479nm) bands
        red = img.select('sur_refl_b01')  # Red
        blue = img.select('sur_refl_b03')  # Blue
        
        # Turbidity proxy: Red/Blue (higher = more turbidity)
        turbidity = red.divide(blue.add(1))  # Add 1 to avoid division by zero
        
        # Get values at loc1
        val1 = turbidity.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=loc1,
            scale=500,
            maxPixels=1e8
        ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
        
        count1 = turbidity.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=loc1,
            scale=500,
            maxPixels=1e8
        ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
        
        # Get values at loc2
        val2 = turbidity.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=loc2,
            scale=500,
            maxPixels=1e8
        ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
        
        count2 = turbidity.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=loc2,
            scale=500,
            maxPixels=1e8
        ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Location 1: Turbidity={val1:.3f}, Pixels={count1}")
        print(f"Location 2: Turbidity={val2:.3f}, Pixels={count2}")
        
        if val1 is None or val2 is None or count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
            print("C2")
        elif val1 > val2:
            print("A")
        else:
            print("B")
else:
    # Use MOD04 Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD)
    img = col.first()
    
    # Extract AOD band (550nm)
    aod = img.select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean')
    
    # Get AOD values at loc1
    val1 = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=loc1,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e8
    ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    count1 = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=loc1,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e8
    ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    # Get AOD values at loc2
    val2 = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=loc2,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e8
    ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    count2 = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=loc2,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e8
    ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Location 1 (33.71, 136.03): AOD={val1:.3f}, Pixels={count1}")
    print(f"Location 2 (33.88, 136.37): AOD={val2:.3f}, Pixels={count2}")
    
    if val1 is None or val2 is None or count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("C2")
    elif val1 > val2:
        print("A")
    else:
        print("B")
